title: 第9章 万相灵女人尽可夫第10章 灵源宝树传承雷法
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
“天然聚灵阵……催生灵植生长……”
周元敏锐的捕捉到了地髓石真正的妙用。换个地方埋到地里，岂不是还能孕育出新的地元参？
其他灵植埋到地髓石附近，也可能从百年级，孕育到千年级。无论是药效还是价值，都将十倍百倍的翻升。
“二爷……”周元捧着宝石，声音都在颤抖。
“激动吧？好东西啊。”
“你真牛逼！”周元确实激动，但激动的不只是命血换来的千年地元参和地髓石，而是二爷。
他想象里的福缘推演，只是几株能帮助修炼的宝物，没想到竟是如此改命般的机缘。
不愧是半仙级别的存在啊。
有了二爷，他的灵途将有大期待。
“……”
二爷很无奈，这小子每次夸他，都让他高兴不起来呢：“知道我的厉害就行了，等哪天我需要你帮忙了，但愿你也不要吝啬。”
“需要什么帮忙？我义不容辞！”
“以后再说吧，把地髓石藏起来，千万不能让任何人知道它的存在。
怀璧其罪是灵修世界无数条性命堆起来的经验。
地元参用的时候……划破皮……只用灵液……每次一滴……我……再睡会儿……”
二爷声音越来越微弱，竟重新陷入了沉睡。
“二爷苏醒有时间限制吗？？”
“精血唤醒，命血推演？”
“以后精血变强了，二爷苏醒的时间应该会更长吧。”
周元把地髓石和地元参贴身装好，爬出深坑，跑进了浓密森然林子。

天黑前，找到了一处隐蔽的岩洞，确定是空置的，放心钻了进去。
取出地元参，划破皮，小心的挤出一滴，含到嘴里。
汁液没什么味道，顺喉而下后却很快腾起了丝丝热意，沁入经脉，汇聚到了丹田。
“百年级的能提升一倍炼化速度，千年级的呢？”
周元尝试着运转起了吞灵诀。
轰！轰！
雷霆之音接连响起，天地间的雷灵之气受到牵引，进入周元身体，在经脉间反复流转，经受吞灵诀的炼化。不多时，一缕纯净的雷灵之气便进入了丹田。
周元睁开眼，眼底泛起狂喜。
他计算着时间呢，竟然用了不到三分钟，而之前是半个小时还多。
“提升了十多倍？！”
“这就是千年地元参的效果吗？”
“不知道这速度跟那些五品天才比起来如何。”
周元聚敛心神，继续运转灵诀，吞纳着周遭躁动的雷灵之气。在地元参灵液的激发下，炼化过程顺畅且迅速，一缕接着一缕的纯净雷气汇入丹田。
更令他惊喜的是，这一滴灵液的药效竟绵长不绝，一直持续了一天一夜！
“一滴能持续一昼夜，这株地元参应该能用很长时间。”
周元拿起手里肥嘟嘟地元参，细小的伤口竟然愈合了，还是金灿灿的，根须似是有着生命般轻缓的蠕动着。他小心翼翼挤出一滴，继续吸收炼化。
如此昼夜轮转，周元乐此不疲地重复着运转灵诀。
饿了就啃几口干粮，倦了便合眼小憩。
这天清晨，丹田猛然鼓胀，磅礴的雷灵之气激荡全身，脏腑震动，筋骨嗡鸣。在这股力量的淬炼下，他的体质再度提升，境界也随之突破——直达三重天。
之前踏入二重天，足足花了半个月。如今更高一重的境界，竟然只用了两天三夜。

云雾山脉深处。
content_en:
"Natural spirit gathering array... promotes the growth of spiritual plants..."
Zhou Yuan keenly captured the true magical effect of the Earth Marrow Stone. If you bury it in another place and bury it in the ground, wouldn't it be possible to breed new Diyuan ginseng?
Other spiritual plants buried near the earth marrow stone may also be gestated from a hundred years to a thousand years. Both the efficacy and value of the medicine will increase tenfold and a hundredfold.
"Second Master..." Zhou Yuan held the gem, his voice trembling.
"Are you excited? Great stuff."
"You are so awesome!" Zhou Yuan was indeed excited, but he was not only excited about the thousand-year Earth Essence Ginseng and Earth Marrow Stone he had obtained in exchange for his life blood, but also the Second Master.
The derivation of good fortune in his imagination was just a few treasures that could help him practice, but he didn't expect it to be such a life-changing opportunity.
It is indeed a semi-immortal level existence.
With the second master, he will have great expectations for his spiritual journey.
"..."
The second master was helpless. Every time this kid praised him, he couldn't be happy: "Just know how good I am. When one day I need your help, I hope you won't be stingy."
"Do you need any help? I'm obligated!"
“Let’s talk about it later, hide the Earth Marrow Stone and never let anyone know of its existence.
The sin of holding a jade is the accumulated experience of countless lives in the spiritual world.
When using Diyuan Ginseng... scratch the skin... only use the spiritual fluid... one drop at a time... I... will sleep a little longer..."
The second master's voice became weaker and weaker, and he fell into a deep sleep again.
"Is there a time limit for Second Master to wake up??"
"Essence and blood awakening, life blood deduction?"
"In the future, as the essence and blood become stronger, it will probably take longer for the second master to wake up."
Zhou Yuan packed the earth marrow stone and earth ginseng close to his body, climbed out of the pit, and ran into the dense forest.
Before dark, I found a hidden cave. I was sure it was vacant, so I felt confident and went in.
Take out the Diyuan ginseng, cut the skin, carefully squeeze out a drop, and put it in your mouth.
The juice has no taste, but after it goes down the throat, it quickly feels warm, penetrates into the meridians, and gathers in the Dantian.
"A hundred-year-old can double the refining speed, but what about a thousand-year-old?"
Zhou Yuan tried to use the Spirit Swallowing Technique.
boom! boom!
The sound of thunder sounded one after another, and the thunder spirit energy between heaven and earth was pulled, entered Zhou Yuan's body, circulated repeatedly among the meridians, and was refined by the Spirit Swallowing Art. Not long after, a wisp of pure thunder spirit energy entered the dantian.
Zhou Yuan opened his eyes, filled with ecstasy.
He calculated the time and found that it took less than three minutes, whereas before it was more than half an hour.
"Improved more than ten times?!"
"Is this the effect of Thousand-year-old Diyuan Ginseng?"
"I don't know how this speed compares with those of fifth-grade geniuses."
Zhou Yuan concentrated his mind and continued to run the spirit arts, absorbing the restless thunder spirit energy around him. Inspired by the earthly ginseng spiritual liquid, the refining process was smooth and rapid, and wisps of pure thunder energy flowed into the Dantian.
What surprised him even more was that the medicinal effect of this drop of spiritual liquid lasted all day and night!
"One drop can last all day and night. This Diyuan Ginseng should last for a long time."
Zhou Yuan picked up the plump ginseng in his hand. The small wound was healed unexpectedly, and it was still golden. The roots seemed to be moving slowly as if they were alive. He carefully squeezed out a drop and continued to absorb and refine it.
With such a cycle of day and night, Zhou Yuan endlessly repeated the Spiritual Movement Technique.
When you're hungry, you'll take a few bites of dry food, and when you're tired, you'll close your eyes and take a nap.
Early that morning, the Dantian suddenly swelled, and the majestic thunder spirit energy stirred up the whole body, causing the internal organs to vibrate and the muscles and bones to buzz. Under the tempering of this power, his physique improved again, and his realm also broke through - reaching the third heaven.
It took half a month to step into the second heaven before. Now, it only took two days and three nights to reach a higher realm.
Deep in the Yunwu Mountains.
